description: Complete the handover: pass the BODY_JSON from prepare_place UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/place/intake); this server holds no keys and no funds. Free with a valid signature. Returns the recorded intake with its id and the Regen account the board derived for you. It is recorded, not accepted: watch it with place_status.

bodyJson.description: The exact BODY_JSON string from prepare_place, unchanged.
